All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
AsyncSubscription
A live Dispatcher.subscribeAsync(io.mavlink4j.session.MessageFilter, java.util.function.Consumer<io.mavlink4j.codec.Frame>) registration: closing it stops delivery and shuts the subscriber's own drain thread down.
ByteChunk
A slice of bytes read off a MavlinkLink in one MavlinkLink.poll(java.time.Duration) call.
CapabilityReport
What a vehicle answered to MAV_CMD_REQUEST_MESSAGE(AUTOPILOT_VERSION) — decoded far enough to be useful, and no further.
CapabilityReport.Maturity
The FIRMWARE_VERSION_TYPE enum, as the low byte of flight_sw_version.
CapabilityReport.Status
 
CapabilityService
"What is this aircraft?"
Command
One MAVLink command to send through CommandService.send(io.mavlink4j.PeerId, io.mavlink4j.service.Command): which MavCmd, and its parameters, named instead of positional.
Command.Positioned
COMMAND_INT: four float parameters, a coordinate frame and an integer position.
Command.Simple
COMMAND_LONG: seven float parameters.
CommandReply
What a FakeVehicle does when a scripted command arrives: send zero or more COMMAND_ACKs.
CommandRequest
A command a FakeVehicle received.
CommandResult
A COMMAND_LONG/COMMAND_INT exchange's terminal result.
CommandResult.Status
How the exchange ended; CommandResult.Status.NO_ACK is silence, the rest map MAV_RESULT.
CommandService
MAVLink's command microservice (command protocol): COMMAND_LONG and COMMAND_INT, awaited as COMMAND_ACK matched on (origin sysid, command id) only.
CompId
A MAVLink component id — one software/hardware component within a system (autopilot, camera, gimbal, a ground controller's own commanding component, ...).
CorrelationKeys
The one place a correlated reply's MatchKey is defined — for both directions (request and reply).
Correlator
The join between MAVLink's outbound request path and its unsolicited-inbound reply path: a pending-request registry that completes a future when a matching reply is decoded.
DirectTxScheduler
A TxScheduler with no threads and no timers: DirectTxScheduler.submit(java.lang.String, java.lang.Runnable) runs inline and a DirectTxScheduler.repeat(java.lang.String, java.time.Duration, java.lang.Runnable) registration only fires when the test calls DirectTxScheduler.tick().
DirectTxScheduler.Registration
One DirectTxScheduler.repeat(java.lang.String, java.time.Duration, java.lang.Runnable) registration, observable by the test.
Dispatcher
Fan-out of decoded frames to subscribers, filtered by MessageFilter.
FakeVehicle
A scripted aircraft over real UDP loopback: it dials the system under test, sends a heartbeat every 200 ms by default (one heartbeat can be lost on plain UDP while the far side is still binding, so the stream never stops), records every frame it receives, and answers on demand or by script.
FakeVehicle.Builder
Describes a FakeVehicle; FakeVehicle.Builder.build() starts it.
Frame
One fully decoded MAVLink frame: header plus payload, stamped with where it came from.
FrameHeader
The wire-level facts of one MAVLink frame, decoded but not interpreted.
FrameReader
Bytes in, frames out.
FrameSink
Frames out — the one public TX door.
FrameWriter
The only class in this module permitted to construct an io.dronefleet.mavlink.MavlinkConnection — every other class reaches the wire through MavlinkLink/FrameReader/this class, never the library directly.
HeartbeatContent
What our own periodic HEARTBEAT says about us.
HeartbeatInfo
The facts a HEARTBEAT message carries about a peer's firmware and current mode, decoded but not interpreted — no firmware-name lookup, no "is this ArduCopter or PX4" labelling.
HeartbeatService
MAVLink's heartbeat microservice (Family B — streaming, see docs/API.md): emits our own HEARTBEAT at a fixed rate, and tracks each known peer's connected/disconnected state against peerTimeout (convention "4-5 missed heartbeats" — not a spec number).
LinkHealth
Per-peer link quality, tracked from observed seq accounting (the spec defines no drop-rate formula — see DefaultLinkHealth for ours, documented as ours, not standard).
LinkHealth.Health
 
LinkId
The stable identity of a MavlinkLink for its whole life, e.g.
LinkIntake
A snapshot of what has arrived at a link's socket, counted pre-parse — before any MAVLink resync or decoding is attempted (that is io.mavlink4j.codec's job, several layers up).
LinkPeer
A physical address on a link — the host/port a datagram was received from or should be sent to.
LinkQuality
Per-link radio-quality telemetry, keyed by LinkId rather than PeerId — a deliberate, separate port from LinkHealth: LinkHealth.Health already collapses to "whichever link this peer was most recently heard on," and folding a per-link RSSI field into it would either go stale the moment a peer is heard on a second link, or force a host's status provider to reason about a dimension it doesn't need.
LinkQuality.Quality
One RADIO_STATUS (#109) snapshot.
LoopbackLinkPair
Two MavlinkLinks wired back to back in memory: what one sends, the other polls.
ManualControlService
MAVLink's manual-control microservice (Family B — streaming, see docs/API.md): a fixed-rate RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE (#70) relay, latest-wins mailbox, no acknowledgement at all, run on this module's own TxScheduler instead of a hand-rolled per-link thread.
ManualControlService.ManualControlLink
An opaque, engaged manual-control relay.
ManualInstantSource
An InstantSource that only moves when the test says so, for MavlinkSettings.builder().clock(...).
MatchKey
The key a Correlator waiter is registered and matched under.
MavlinkLink
Bytes in, bytes out.
MavlinkNode
This node's own MAVLink identity — who a MavlinkSession presents itself as.
MavlinkSession
The L3 composition root: one reader thread per registered MavlinkLink, driving that link's own FrameReader and, for every frame it decodes, updating PeerDirectory and LinkHealth, then offering the frame to Correlator and finally to Dispatcher — in that fixed order, never any other.
MavlinkSettings
Every value the MAVLink spec itself declines to pin (heartbeat rate, peer timeout, command retry policy, ...), the module's own internal bounds (resync buffer cap, dispatch queue capacity, poll interval, scheduler pool size) and the three runtime collaborators the library must never hard-wire: the clock, the thread factory and the executor completions are delivered on.
MavlinkSettings.Builder
Mutable, single-use staging area for a MavlinkSettings; validation happens in MavlinkSettings.Builder.build().
MavlinkSettings.LinkHealth
DefaultLinkHealth's drop-rate accounting: loss is measured over the trailing window only (a restart or a second sender must not haunt the rate forever), and a wrapped seq gap larger than resyncGap is a sender restart / second source, not that many lost frames -- it is counted as one resync and adds no loss.
MavlinkSettings.Parameter
Parameter read/write timing.
MavlinkSettings.PeerSettings
Address-flap detection in the peer directory: a peer heard from two addresses on one link within flapWindow is flagged, and the warning for one peer is repeated at most once per warnInterval so a genuine roam cannot flood the log.
MavlinkSettings.Rc
The fixed-rate RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE relay's cadence.
MavlinkSettings.SigningSettings
Pure numeric signing tuning -- windows, a tolerance, a bound.
MessageFilter
A predicate a Dispatcher subscription tests every decoded frame against.
MessageIntervalService
MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL / MAV_CMD_REQUEST_MESSAGE — both plain COMMAND_LONG exchanges, so this class is a thin, named convenience over CommandService rather than a service with any state or ack logic of its own: the ack cycle is implemented exactly once.
ParameterOutcome
A PARAM_REQUEST_READ or PARAM_SET exchange's terminal result.
ParameterOutcome.Status
 
ParameterService
MAVLink's parameter microservice (parameter protocol): read a named parameter, and write one with a mandatory read-back.
ParameterValue
One aircraft parameter, exactly as the vehicle reported it in a PARAM_VALUE.
Peer
One MAVLink peer this session has observed traffic from — protocol facts only, latest-wins.
PeerDirectory
Who is out there — read-only protocol facts, updated by MavlinkSession as frames arrive.
PeerId
The identity of a MAVLink peer: (system, component).
PeerUnreachableException
A targeted send named a peer nothing has been heard from yet, so no link is known to reach it.
RcChannels
RC channel override values in microseconds, 1-based (index 0 is channel 1) — the payload ManualControlService relays as a MAVLink RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE (#70) frame.
RecordingLink
An in-memory MavlinkLink that records every RecordingLink.send(byte[], int, int, io.mavlink4j.transport.LinkPeer) instead of touching a socket, and hands back whatever the test injects from RecordingLink.poll(java.time.Duration).
RequestResponse
The shared Family-A state machine (see docs/API.md): send X, await a reply matching a MatchKey within a deadline, retry up to N times on silence, and let a reply itself decide whether the exchange is done or should keep waiting a bit longer without a resend.
RequestResponse.AttemptPayload
Builds the payload to send for a given 0-based attempt (0 = first send, 1.. = timeout retries).
RequestResponse.ReplyClassifier
Classifies a reply that matched the MatchKey: null means the reply is terminal (the exchange completes with it); a non-null, positive Duration means "keep waiting on the same key for this long, without resending" (Family-A's IN_PROGRESS-style continuation).
SerialChannel
The byte-level seam SerialLink polls/writes through.
SerialLink
A serial (jSerialComm-backed) MavlinkLink — modelled line-for-line on TcpClientLink: SerialLink.preservesMessageBoundaries() is honestly false (one SerialLink.poll(java.time.Duration) may return less than one frame, more than one, or a frame split across several polls, exactly like a TCP stream), id is stable for the port's whole life ("serial:" + portDescriptor), and SerialLink.send(byte[], int, int, io.mavlink4j.transport.LinkPeer)'s target parameter is accepted for interface uniformity only — a serial wire has exactly one destination, the far end of the cable, which SerialLink.defaultTarget() honestly reports as LinkPeer.NONE (a serial link has no addressable network peer at all, unlike UDP/TCP).
SerialLinks
Production factory for SerialLink: opens a real serial port through jSerialComm, so the core library itself stays free of any native dependency.
SignatureRejection
A frame FrameReader decoded but did not dispatch, because SignatureVerifier itself refused it or because SigningPolicy.accept(int, SignatureStatus) did, given a verifier result it chose not to accept.
SignatureRejection.Reason
Why the frame was refused.
SignatureStatus
The cryptographic-validity dimension of a decoded MAVLink 2 frame, orthogonal to FrameHeader.signed() (the raw wire bit).
Signing
The one collaborator bundle FrameReader/FrameWriter/ io.mavlink4j.session.MavlinkSession thread signing through: a key resolver, a policy and a clock registry.
SigningClock
The MAVLink 2 signing timestamp for one remote system (VERIFIED, mavlink.io message-signing spec): a 48-bit counter in 10 microsecond ticks since SigningClock.SIGNING_EPOCH, not Unix epoch -- a naive millisecond- or microsecond-since-1970 implementation produces a value that looks plausible and fails every verification silently (QA item 3).
SigningClocks
One SigningClock per remote system id -- a signing timestamp is a per-vehicle fact (two vehicles must never share a monotonic counter), never a process-wide one.
SigningKeyResolver
The sysid→key lookup the library cannot own: which 32-byte secret belongs to which vehicle is the host application's knowledge (a key store, a device registry), so the host supplies the implementation and the library only consumes the interface.
SigningPolicy
Decides whether a decoded frame is dispatched, given its origin sysid and SignatureStatus.
Subscription
A live Dispatcher.subscribe(io.mavlink4j.session.MessageFilter, java.util.function.Consumer<io.mavlink4j.codec.Frame>) registration.
SysId
A MAVLink system id — one physical vehicle or ground controller on the network.
TcpClientLink
Dials out to a fixed remote host:port over TCP.
TxScheduler
Runs named periodic TX tasks (heartbeat emission, RC override relay, ...) on one shared thread pool rather than one hand-rolled thread loop per feature, so every periodic sender shares one thread lifecycle.
TxScheduler.Handle
A live TxScheduler.repeat(java.lang.String, java.time.Duration, java.lang.Runnable) registration.
UdpListenLink
Listens — binds a local UDP address and accepts datagrams from whoever sends to it.
UdpTargetLink
Dials a fixed destination from an ephemeral local UDP port — the shape a TX simulator needs (send a synthetic feed at one configured address).
VehicleKind
The vehicle family a MAVLink HEARTBEAT.type (MAV_TYPE) belongs to.
